=== qgis healthcheck def === healthcheck: test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -q -O /dev/null 'http://localhost/?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities' || exit 1"] interval: 30s timeout: 30s retries: 3 networks: - qonnectra_network logging: driver: "json-file" options: max-size: "10m" max-file: "3" pg-error-parser: build: context: ../backend dockerfile: Dockerfile image: qonnectra/pg-error-parser:dev container_name: qonnectra_pg_error_parser_dev restart: unless-stopped command: python manage.py parse_pg_errors --container qonnectra_db_dev === qgis root response === Welcome to nginx!

observation.command:
cd /workspace/deployment
echo "=== qgis healthcheck def ==="; sed -n '130,150p' docker-compose.dev.yml
echo "=== qgis root response ==="; docker exec qonnectra_qgis_server_dev wget -qO- "http://localhost:80/?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities" 2>&1 | head -c 400
echo; echo "=== tilejson vs monaco bounds ==="; docker run --rm -v /workspace/deployment/tiles/germany.mbtiles:/g.mbtiles --entrypoint sh maptiler/tileserver-gl:v5.6.0 -c "command -v sqlite3 && sqlite3 /g.mbtiles 'select name,value from metadata where name in (\"bounds\",\"minzoom\",\"maxzoom\");'" 2>&1 | tail -5
